message:
fix(mobile): prevent save options page from overscrolling

Override justify-content on .tab-container > .l-antimatter-dim-tab to
flex-start so tab content starts at the top instead of being centered,
eliminating phantom scroll space below content. Also reduce
.c-cloud-options-header margin-top from 4rem to 1rem on mobile.
